opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
[[4.1] Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and more particularly the fact that charge is only of sub- standardization of goods and request is made by learned advocate appearing for the petitioner and considering the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Nemi Chand (supra), she has requested to pass appropriate order.

Shah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of respondent no.2 and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly, when the charge against the petitioner is only of sub standardization of the goods and that original accused was convicted for the offence under Section 16(1)(A) (1) of the Act and for the offence under Section 2(ia)(a)(m) and Section 7(1)
